title: Drunk Woman Loses It Over Bar Tab, Throws Drink at Bartender, Gets Arrested!
description:
On October 1st, 2023, officers in Ohio were dispatched to a local bar after receiving reports of a disturbance involving a female patron. Upon arrival, officers were directed to a female matching the description provided by dispatch. The suspect, who was reportedly arguing with the bartender and refusing to leave, ignored officers' attempts to engage with her. As officers tried to speak with her about the complaints, she became belligerent and continued to raise her voice, refusing to cooperate or leave the establishment.

Witnesses at the scene, including bar employees, stated that the suspect had thrown an alcoholic beverage at the bartender and attempted to get behind the bar. Despite being asked multiple times to leave, the suspect refused, causing a significant disturbance. The situation escalated when the suspect continued to ignore officers' commands and walked away, prompting officers to arrest her. During the arrest, the suspect resisted, leading to a physical confrontation where she was placed in handcuffs.

After being placed in the patrol car, the suspect continued to be uncooperative, yelling and complaining about the arrest before being transported to jail. The suspect was charged with Obstructing Official Business and Disorderly Conduct.
